versions.changelog:
- Initial release of lygo-api-token-saver.
- Minimizes xAI/API token spend by prioritizing local Ollama and alternate xAI keys.
- Activates when triggered by phrases like "token saver," "API budget," or before long Grok/Claude/GPT calls.
- Encourages compressed agent behavior: short replies, prefer tables, minimal full-context API calls.
- Provides setup instructions for local processing (Ollama army) and API budget self-check.
- Requires explicit user intent to use high-cost models or large-scale API runs.
